title: Nonequilibrium Equation of State for a Turbulent 2D Bose Gas
summary: Nonequilibrium equations of state can provide an effective thermodynamiclike description of far-from-equilibrium systems. title: Rapid Cavity-Based Midcircuit Measurement and Feedforward in a Neutral Atom Array
summary: Measuring part of a quantum system in the midst of its evolution and acting on the result in real time is essential for numerous quantum information protocols. summary: We theoretically propose a Hall effect driven by effective gravitational fields arising from quantum geometry. title: Kovacs Memory Effect in a Thin Granular Layer: Experimental Evidence and Its Physical Origin
summary: A memory phenomenon known as the anomalous Kovacs effect has been experimentally observed in a granular system for the first time.

title: Exploring Noisy Quantum Thermodynamical Processes via the Depolarizing-Channel Approximation
summary: Noise and errors are unavoidable in any realistic quantum process, including processes designed to reduce noise and errors in the first place. title: Nanohertz Gravitational-Wave Constraints on Supermassive Binary Black Holes at Cosmic Dawn
summary: Researchers have used radio observations of rapidly spinning neutron stars to search for signals from supermassive black hole pairs at the dawn of galaxy formation.

title: Detecting Tidal Resonances in Binary Neutron Stars
summary: As a binary neutron star inspirals due to the emission of gravitational waves, the rising tidal frequency resonantly excites vibrational modes. summary: Fluctuational electrodynamics relies on the assumption that thermal fluctuations in distinct bodies are statistically independent. It is shown that this approximation ceases to be valid in the extreme near-field regime, where hybridization of surface phonon polaritons across nanometric vacuum gaps g…

title: Incoherent Imaging with Spatially Structured Quantum Probes
summary: Researchers introduce spatially structured quantum-optical imaging techniques to overcome resolution limits and achieve quantum-enhanced absorption and fluorescence imaging.

title: Stability, Degeneracy, and Scalability of a 600-Site Cavity Array Microscope
summary: A scalable cavity array microscope architecture is presented, featuring over 600 independent optical cavities for parallelized light-matter interactions, providing opportunities for quantum networking and sensing applications.

title: Theory of Out-of-Time-Ordered Transport
summary: Researchers establish an effective field theory capturing late-time out-of-time-order correlators to uncover hidden transport parameters.

title: Spin Nematic Liquid Crystal and Scalar Spin Chirality in Tetragonal Lattice ${\mathrm{YbMnBi}}_{2}$
summary: Neutron scattering experiments on reveal that a dynamic spin nematic state coupled to magnetic fields generates scalar spin chirality, driving anomalous Hall and Nernst effects in the paramagnetic phase.

title: Phonon-Activated Collective Hopping in a Superionic Phase
summary: Observations of collective hopping in superionic agryodites improves the microscopic understanding of transport in these materials.

title: Generation of Large Coherent-State Superpositions in Free-Space Optical Pulses
summary: Researchers generate large-amplitude optical cat states in free space, establishing a vital building block for fault-tolerant quantum computing.

title: Bounded-Error Quantum Simulation via Hamiltonian and Lindbladian Learning
summary: Researchers introduce a framework that infers quantum dynamics and error bounds from experimental data to validate large-scale quantum simulations.

title: Unified Symmetry Classification of Magnetic Orders via Spin Space Groups: Prediction of Coplanar Even-Wave Phases
summary: A unified classification framework based on spin space group symmetry predicts a coplanar even-wave magnetic phase where electronic band spin polarization varies continuously and can vanish without band degeneracy.

title: Mechanochemical Nano-Writing of an Atomically Thin Metal
summary: A large stress generated by a small tip drives a reaction between two materials in an 2D encapsulated space to produce a new material with interesting electronic properties that can be written into patterns as small as 50 nm.

title: Free Probability in a Minimal Quantum Circuit Model
summary: Researchers characterize out-of-time-order correlation functions in a quantum circuit model, mapping system-bath interactions to free probability structures.

title: Quantum Geometric Tensor Determines the Pure-State I.I.D. Conversion Rate in the Resource Theory of Asymmetry for Any Compact Lie Group
summary: Researchers prove that the quantum geometric tensor completely dictates pure-state asymptotic conversion rates under any compact Lie group symmetry.

title: Predicting Liquid Properties and Behavior via Droplet Pinch-off and Machine Learning
summary: A powerful method allows hard to measure properties like viscosity and surface tension to be determined from a single, high-speed snapshot.

title: Deceleration of Accelerator-Produced and In-Trap Electron Cooling of Highly Charged Ions
summary: The electron cooling of highly charged ions (HCI) in a Penning trap, as well as the deceleration and trapping of accelerator-produced HCI, has been demonstrated at the HITRAP facility, paving the way for unprecedented precision experiments in QED, materials science, and astrophysics.
